ns2:section.sectionText: This course will introduce undergraduate students to the basic elements of research, forms of technical communication, and the responsible conduct of research in preparation for their research abroad experience. Through the course, students will gain an understanding about the logical tramework of research and learn to communicate effectively about research. **This section is open to engineering students participating in research abroad in the summer.**
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Grainger Engineering. Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
